plainTranslation: Deep emotional pull. You read each other's depths fast. Powerful, easily possessive. Watch jealousy and the urge to merge completely. Hard aspects bring control battles; soft ones bring intimacy without the grip. If it runs on fear, that's not closeness.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
